results.title: For Me, For You
results.overview: Haunted by the collateral damage of his own ego, a young man sits with a notebook of past regrets and attempts to heal by leaving behind a message of forgiveness rather than fear.

results.title: Convince Me
results.overview: When a heartbroken man is forced to convince the Devil to grant his wish, he must face the truth about himself or risk paying an eternal price.

results.title: All Rivers Spill Their Stories to the Sea
results.original_title: All Rivers Spill Their Stories to the Sea
results.overview: On England’s North East coast, where rivers, heavy industry and the sea have shaped lives for generations, fisherman Stan Rennie is watching the world he knows disappear. His family have worked these waters for generations. Then, almost overnight, thousands of dead crabs and lobsters wash ashore, and a community already living with uncertainty is pushed into crisis. Teesside filmmaker Jeanie Finlay brings warmth, wit and deep local feeling to this David-and-Goliath story of environmental damage, official evasions and working-class resilience. At its centre is Stan: funny, stubborn, vulnerable and increasingly determined to be heard.

results.title: Friday the 69th
results.overview: Porn filmmakers in 1981 seek to cash in on the slasher craze by making their own independent ripoff that follows a group of spring breaking college coeds as they are stalked by a mysterious killer beekeeper at a camp with a tragic past.

results.title: The Rarest Thing in the World
results.original_title: The Rarest Thing in the World
results.overview: Having been confronted with the opportunity to erase his memory and start a new life as a political celebrity, a despondent man must decide whether he should embrace his current life or forget it.

results.title: The Castle
results.overview: "The Castle" follows three siblings left to fend for themselves after their mother suddenly disappears. Connor, Jamie, and Mia try to keep their lives afloat, transforming their suburban house into a makeshift fortress as they wait for her return. Told through the eyes of wildly imaginative middle brother Connor, "The Castle" traces fraying sibling relationships, survival strategies, and the grand stories children tell each other to feel safe. A tender, soulful story about growing up too soon, and rescuing yourself before it’s too late.

results.title: Haiku
results.overview: A charismatic young man uses poetry to navigate the complex maze of modern romance to protect his fragile relationship. Later, he must overcome deep generational divides to keep his love alive.

results.title: The Girl looking for the cabin
results.original_title: La Fille à la recherche de la cabane
results.overview: During the winter of 2011, the young street artist Bilal Berreni travelled to the far north of Sweden and locks himself away in a wooden cabin, to live as a hermit. Ten years later, after Bilal's death, I'm following in his footsteps, looking for his cabin...

results.title: Someone's Daughter
results.overview: A criminal defence lawyer, Sam, (Pascale Bussières, Ma Vie en cinémascope, When Night is Falling), finds herself kidnapped and abandoned on a remote island along with former client Paul (François Arnaud, Heated Rivalry, Fucktoys, The Borgias), who she previously cleared of sexual assault charges. As they make their way through the unrelenting Canadian wilderness, Paul’s behaviour forces Sam to question the man she once defended. As doubt gives way to fear, she finds herself facing a choice no lawyer should ever have to make.

results.title: The River Train
results.overview: Nine-year-old Milo lives in a remote Argentinian village where he studies the Malambo, a folk dance full of bravura. He is an excellent dancer, but Milo’s only desire is to escape the countryside on a train for the Buenos Aires of his dreams.

results.title: Neural Command
results.overview: In a cold future, where society is controlled by technology. Ethan, has a flash of his life before and starts to question what it means to truly live.

results.title: Coast to Coast
results.overview: An overworked bureaucrat is tasked to fix the broken office printer when his routine errand spirals into a surreal odyssey across the island.

results.title: A Possession in Lincoln County
results.overview: A man documents his wife's cancer-until a terminal diagnosis leads him to an ancient ritual to summon the Devil and make a deal. His footage spirals into a chilling record of kidnapping, demonic rituals, and the price of desperation.

results.title: The Fade of Day
results.overview: Hunted by an unforeseen threat, a young father seeks refuge in the countryside. Stripped of his bearings, he questions the legacy he will offer to his newborn child.

results.title: La sera a Roma
results.overview: Federico, a journalist from Rome, finds himself the prime suspect following the murder of a young actor he had just met; he is forced to defend himself while his private life comes under scrutiny.

results.title: Made in Abyss: Mezameru Shinpi
results.original_title: メイドインアビス 目覚める神秘
results.overview: Sequel to Made in Abyss: The Golden City of the Scorching Sun.

results.title: Doble-6
results.overview: A group of friends play an ancient "cursed" board game — and a death foretold becomes reality. To stop the spirit of their deceased friend, they must face paranormal forces, an eccentric shaman, and the absurd rules of the game itself. Horror with humor and a double 6.

results.title: The Bog
results.overview: A boy's body is discovered in a peat field, and a local drunk confesses to a decades-old murder. Policeman Broze reopens the case and is forced to confront his own role in the tragic game played by boys 30 years ago—a day he can't remember or forget.

results.title: Terrestrial
results.overview: A reunion weekend spirals out of control for four college friends when the host - a science fiction writer on the verge of newfound success - fights to maintain his sense of reality in the face of sudden, uncanny dangers.

results.title: Bad Lieutenant: Tokyo
results.original_title: バッド・ルーテナント：トウキョウ
results.overview: A corrupt gambler in the Metropolitan Police Force finds himself thrown into a tangled case after an enigmatic FBI agent arrives in Tokyo to investigate the disappearance of a politician’s daughter.
